summary: Murlok +40 from a fresh 18:36Z recut; 240 tier letters re-parsed, 0 moves. Bloodmallet crossed to MID2 but 19/27 - held. Archon walled night 3. 7 creator takes from 3 transcripts.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 73-281 KB (r.jina.ai deliberately not tried - it is IP-403 on these hosts). <style> blocks stripped BEFORE parsing, because the page ships its whole tier-list CSS inline and an unstripped anchor finds stylesheet rules; the <table class="tier-list"> block count was then asserted EXACTLY 1 per page. Letter read from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster. Counts reconciled to 27/7/6 per bracket = 80 rows BEFORE any merge: 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, every letter inside the registered 7-band icyveins scale. Upstream still publishes exactly TWO M+ DPS specs as TBD (Windwalker Monk, Frost Death Knight) and both stay explicit nulls. ALL 80 letters are byte-identical to stored, so nothing was merged and specs.json is untouched by this source. Page self-dates re-read from JSON-LD dateModified and unchanged: raid DPS 2026-08-23, raid healer 2026-08-24, raid tank 2026-08-08, M+ DPS 2026-08-23, M+ healer 2026-08-23, M+ tank 2026-08-23 - identical to the stored published values AND to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact, so that cross-check has three agreeing witnesses. Era-verified s2 on all six from the BODY, not the title: the raid HEALER page still titles itself 'Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight' while its body is Season 2 throughout - body over title, the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified unchanged (s2 on all six), so freeze-season had nothing to consider. NOTE ON THE DATES: this is the SECOND run of 2026-08-27 (the earlier one started 14:59Z), so the page snapshots were already at today's date and could not advance further; they were not re-bumped, and this row's success rests on a live fetch and full re-parse performed by this run at ~20:47Z, not on the earlier run's stamp.

Both pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB. CSS stripped before parsing, letters read from each tier__tier block's tier__title, specs from each entry's img alt. Extra tierlists rejected by ROSTER MATCH, never by position: the M+ page's nine unmatched images are the eight dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) plus the Method logo, and the raid page's single unmatched image is the logo. 40 rows per bracket, 0 duplicates, letters confined to the registered 4-band method scale S|A|B|C. All 80 letters byte-identical to stored - nothing merged. Page self-dates read from the body's 'Last Updated' line: raid 10th August 2026, M+ 13th August 2026 (the M+ list is bylined Tactyks), both unchanged. Era-verified s2 from the body: the raid page says 'the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss' and the M+ page 'dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2'; Devourer present in both. Method carries no published field in the registry, so these self-dates are recorded here rather than written into sources.json - adding a field is registry structure, not an agent-updatable value. Snapshots were already at today's date from the 14:59Z run of the same day and were not re-bumped; the success rests on this run's own fetch and re-parse.

All 6 pages fetched with the full browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB; r.jina.ai deliberately NOT tried first, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Parse: unescape backslash-slash across the WHOLE document FIRST, then locate [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] in the unescaped text - never anchored on WH.markup.printHtml(, the decoy that once returned 0 rows for the raid-healer page. Exactly ONE tier-list block found per page, asserted. Tier labels matched with tolerant whitespace and specs resolved from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug, which sidesteps the two-word-class split. Counts reconciled before merging: 27/7/6 per bracket = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, letters inside the registered 7-band wowhead scale. ZERO letters moved. Page self-dates from dateModified are byte-identical to stored and to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact on all six: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-18, raid tank 2026-08-14, M+ DPS 2026-08-18, M+ healer 2026-08-26, M+ tank 2026-08-18. The M+ healer page is the one that rebuilt on 08-26 and carried last night's single Holy Priest C->B move; it has not re-dated again and its letters have not moved again, which is the right shape for real upstream movement settling. Era-verified s2 on all six from body and title; Devourer present in both DPS pages. seasonVerified unchanged. Snapshots already at today's date from the earlier run of the same day and not re-bumped. Standing flag, unchanged and still an owner decision (flag, never retire): all four bylined Wowhead tier-list pages are written by registered creators (raid DPS + raid tank Dratnos, M+ DPS tettles, M+ healer AutomaticJak, M+ tank YoDaTV).

Site-wide human-verification wall for a THIRD consecutive night, and its shape changed: every registered page now returns HTTP 200 carrying a ~2.5 KB 'Human Verification / One Quick Check' interstitial rather than the 403 of 08-25/08-26, so a status-code check would misread it as a successful fetch of an empty page. Measured rather than inferred: the site ROOT https://www.archon.gg/wow returns the same interstitial (it is not a tier list and has no reason to be gated on its own), and a second transport, r.jina.ai, returns HTTP 403 with Cloudflare's 'Just a moment...' challenge - the proxy is stopped one layer earlier. Two transports plus a root probe is what makes 'the site is walled' a measurement about upstream rather than a guess about our parse. Matches what the same-day local run measured from a residential IP, so the wall is not IP-scoped and not a CI artifact. Nothing merged, no snapshot bumped, stored letters byte-identical. Standing consequence worth keeping in view: Archon is the only tier source still describing S1 ('updating for 12.1' on every bracket), so this wall is also blocking the one consensus recomposition the anomaly gate is waiting for.

Not reachable - same site-wide human-verification wall as archon-tiers (HTTP 200 + interstitial on every page including the site root; r.jina.ai 403 with the Cloudflare challenge). data/encounter-tiers.json untouched; its season stamp and all tier rows are byte-identical, and the Fight selector stays season-gated out of the UI as designed.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers. spec.survivability untouched. Independently of the wall the documented dead end still stands: the aggregate raid survivability tierList has published EMPTY across all three roles since 2026-08-16, and sourcing it from a per-boss page is a measured dead end (2 of 9 bosses publish it, the only complete 40/40 set is a world boss, 21 of 38 specs disagree between the two populated bosses, and the numeric column sits at 1-2 parses). Correct behaviour is to leave the stored aggregate standing.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers; the specRankingsSection JSON lives behind the same interstitial as the tierList. Recorded as its own row rather than folded into a single Archon row, per the split-row rule, so it stays visible which of the six numeric series failed. Stored '95th pct DPS (Mythic)' rows byte-identical, coverage date correctly stays 2026-08-25. Fire Mage remains absent by upstream design (nobody logs it at Mythic), which is data rather than a failure.
Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers. Stored '95th pct HPS (Mythic)' rows byte-identical, coverage date stays 2026-08-25. Kept as its own row per the split-row rule.

This is the dense early-season series and, since the 2026-08-25 owner decision, the basis of Archon's raid LETTERS, so its staleness matters more than the Mythic cut's - the red is the honest signal.

Upstream frozen for 16 days; both endpoints fetched fine, so this is not our transport. Two plain curls, no headers, no proxy: manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39Z) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returning Last-Modified 'Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT' - the two agree. Per the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest lesson the PAYLOAD was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === 'lowerBound' AND keyRange undefined selects exactly 3 blocks = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, and all 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts are identical to stored at the series' 1-dp stored precision. Nothing to merge, so asOf correctly stays at the source's own 2026-08-11 snapshotDate and the coverage date does not move. This is the owner-accepted standing red recorded on the contract row - it clears when WoWMeta re-runs; do not ack it away and do not raise maxAgeDays.

Read from the pre-agent evidence file, not from any fetch of ours: wcl-fetch/evidence.json, attemptedAt 2026-08-27T20:43:50.882Z, verdict 'rdps-broken'. Transport is healthy on both legs (oauth true, graphql true, 3600 points/hour with 1 spent), and the single sanctioned retry - characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 - returned HTTP 200 carrying 'Internal server error' with 0 rankings. Both 'landed' and 'rawRecipes' are empty objects, so no key could honestly claim success. This is the owner-accepted standing red on the contract row: no zone-53 fetch path exists while the HTML statistics transport is Cloudflare-blocked and the GraphQL rdps family errors. Stored 'Median ... (Mythic ...)' medians byte-identical at their 2026-08-10 coverage date. This agent made no warcraftlogs.com request of any kind, by any means.

(M+, all dungeons ...)' medians stay byte-identical at their 2026-08-10 coverage date. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when a zone-55 recipe lands, not by acking. MERGED 40 rows. Plain browser-UA GET on the three meta pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 71.3 / 42.3 / 40.9 KB. Crucially this is a NEWER cut than the one the 14:59Z run merged: all three pages carry a machine-readable <time datetime="2026-08-27T18:36:2xZ">, so the values genuinely moved within the day. The prose beside it reads 'Updated 49 minutes ago' against a real ~2h10m and is ignored, per the standing rule to use the machine-readable cut time and not the prose. Parse anchored on the BARE 'meta-item' class token inside the <a> tag rather than on 'class="vi-box meta-item', because murlok varies its attribute order and the strict form silently drops href-first rows - 3 of 40 tonight, which would have left three stale ceilings under a fresh date. 27 / 7 / 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, ranks verified contiguous 1..N on each page before merging. All 40 values moved, 38 up and 2 down; largest Demonology +1.06% (3307 -> 3342), then Augmentation -1.29% and Destruction -0.83%, median about +0.4% - far under maxValueMovePct 0.6 and consistent with a few hours of top-50 rating churn. Stored as integers to match the series' own precision; no n (murlok exposes none). All three pages self-identify 'Midnight Season 2 ... Patch 12.1'. asOf = 2026-08-27, the cut's own date.

HELD WHOLESALE, and the reason CHANGED tonight - this is no longer 'upstream has not re-simmed'. All 27 DPS specs requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each: 19 returned real charts and 8 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body (Havoc, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution, Arms, Fury - the documented persistent set minus Devourer and Windwalker, which have now re-simmed). Every one of the 19 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (ptr is the string "0", as documented) with chart timestamps 2026-08-26, against 26 stored profiles all on MID1 at 2026-07-08/07-15. So bloodmallet has crossed the season tier boundary but is 8 specs short of complete, which is exactly the partial-pool case the tier-uniformity gate exists for: fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so merging the 19 would publish WHICH specs have been re-simmed as if it were spec strength. Two other gates agree independently: 19 of 26 rows is past maxRowDropPct 0.25, and all 19 moved +61% to +125% (the ~1.79x MID1->MID2 scale, not spec movement), past maxValueMovePct 0.6. Merged NOTHING; stored fightProfile values, tiers and dates are byte-identical and the coverage date correctly stays 2026-07-08. FLAG FOR THE OWNER: the eventual landing will be a wholesale MID2 adoption and will need a human value_move_ack - the value-move gate has no agent-writable proposal channel.

HELD, second consecutive night, and the 08-21 objection is now half-resolved. MID1_Raid.txt is currently a 272-byte in-progress log with no 'DPS Ranking:' block, so the HTML was read per the documented fallback: MID1_Raid.html is 37 MB, Last-Modified 2026-08-08, header '12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974)' - exactly the state the stored 26 rows came from, i.e. unchanged upstream rather than unfetched. MID2_Raid.txt (1.2 MB, Last-Modified 2026-08-27T07:27Z) DOES now carry a ranking block AND its header self-identifies '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-08-26/69497, git build HEAD 32146c2cc6)' - Live, not PTR, which was the 08-21 blocker. What blocks it now is coverage: its 38 profiles map by longest-prefix to only 19 of 27 DPS roster specs (missing Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution, Arms, Fury - the same eight bloodmallet is missing, which says where the upstream re-sim queue is rather than being a coincidence), and those 19 sit +61% to +125% above their stored MID1 values. Adopting 19 of 26 would trip both the row-drop floor and maxValueMovePct, and mixing MID1 and MID2 rows under one series is the mislabel the honest-typing rule forbids. Merged nothing; stored rows byte-identical, coverage date stays 2026-08-08. Owner-accepted standing red, clearing when a COMPLETE Live MID2 report lands.

Fetched live and verified current; nothing to merge, because upstream has not recut since this morning. /period/latest HTTP 200, 205 KB, resolving to period 1078, week 2 of MID2, with the identical subtitle to the 14:59Z run's merge - 10,000 characters (4,397 unique), 15.4 average key level - so the period has matured no further within the day. Parse BOUNDED to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section, ending at the 'Classes and specs' heading; scanning the whole page instead picks up the classes block and the per-dungeon sections and yields the wrong chart under the right series name. Labels normalised across the lowercase-hyphenated form and the value taken from the <span class="mt-1"> AFTER the bar's height: style, so the bar height is not read as the value. 40 rows, 0 unmatched. Shape checks before deciding: sum 100.1% and role subtotals matching the page's own group headings (Ranged 31.4 / Melee 28.6 / Tank 20 / Healer 20), i.e. the representation SHARE column rather than the /meta per-key-presence figure. All 40 values byte-identical to stored, so specs.json is untouched by this source and the coverage date correctly stays at today's date rather than being re-stamped onto unchanged data.

All 44 transcribable channels polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each; dates are the newest distilled take before and after this run. All THREE queued videos had transcripts pre-fetched by the deterministic step (transcript-fetch/summary.json attemptedAt 2026-08-27T20:43:53Z, verdict 'ok', 3 requested / 3 fetched) and all three were distilled: 7 takes added, 6 prior takes superseded, 0 metaNotes. Kalamazi's A7ZMRYQALHw is the post-buff counterpart to his 08-22 preview and reverses its central prediction - Demonology raid + M+ both buff (taking over stacked-cleave bosses; 'gapping' many keys, with utility rather than throughput as the brake), Destruction raid + M+ both mixed (keeps its high end, loses the default slot). Critcake's inGFY23zA-c gives one Fury M+ take logged MIXED rather than buff, because he undercuts his own comparison three ways including 'I am mashing buttons a lot harder when I'm playing Fury'. AutomaticJak's wgwLOufz5r8 gives two RAID takes - Restoration Shaman buff, Preservation Evoker mixed. Three things deliberately NOT distilled: Kalamazi's Affliction material (fight-shaped only, so a fight artifact rather than a spec read); an Arms take from Critcake (Arms appears only as the comparator in a claim its author discounts); and the Priest passage in the AutomaticJak clip (it names no spec, and two of its ability references - Rescue, Zephyr - are Evoker's). Queue maintenance: the 3 distilled ids removed from videos[], 5 new in-scope videos appended (izen's 'Season 2 Mythic+ Meta', Musguete's Outlaw guide, two AutomaticJak Priest videos, one Critcake key run). Seen-set union 1,207; 199 unseen in-cycle videos, of which the 194 not queued stay UNSEEN rather than being written to seen[] - they are a nightly keyword/budget cut, which is exactly the dismissal class that must remain reconsiderable. Nightly keyword filtering kept, per the 100-request monthly Supadata budget. No YouTube or transcript-API request was made by this agent.
